long_biography.plain_text:
Coral Sea Marina was a distressed Whitsundays asset when Paul Darrouzet acquired it in 2013. He directed a decade of redevelopment that expanded the marina's infrastructure, joined it with the neighbouring resort and repositioned it as a destination for marine tourism. The project extended a career previously centred on construction and mining into regional tourism and marina operations.

Darrouzet's business foundation came from Foxleigh, a metallurgical-coal project he co-founded, chaired and developed with three partners in Queensland's Bowen Basin. After the mine reached export-scale production, the original developers sold their interests when Anglo American acquired control. Darrouzet later backed medical-diagnostics company Ellume and supported Wesley Medical Research. At Coral Sea Marina, he has coupled commercial redevelopment with sponsorship of local rescue, sporting and conservation programs.
